scope: All 34 GitHub issues after the initial 27-issue audit and concrete follow-up creation

issues.title: [MVP tracker] Sugar Maple — local-first UI design, preview and developer handoff
issues.delivered: Canvas/QA-01–QA-10 (#45), native CI/access (#52), early MCP (#53), typography (#54) and typed forms/overlays (#56) are merged. Issues #3/#20/#46/#47 are closed on verified main.
issues.remaining: Complete remaining MVP acceptance; post-MVP remains deferred. Operational review recovery candidate #58 tracks #55.

issues.title: [MVP] Validate Canvas design / DOM preview architecture and record decisions
issues.delivered: Actual Just-Maple Whiteboard Canvas2D is integrated. DOM preview/export and shared scene truth remain; Canvas/DOM parity fixtures pass.
issues.remaining: Record end-to-end p95 frame/startup/memory on the agreed mixed-node fixture in both engines and a 10,000-node diagnostic. CPU flush timings do not satisfy that gate.

issues.title: [MVP] Bootstrap reproducible Angular and macOS development builds
issues.delivered: Pinned clean-checkout web/macOS CI, offline app assets/fonts and actual native filesystem checks pass on main. macOS 15.4+ is supported after #54.
issues.remaining: Release notarization/distribution is separate #21.

issues.title: [MVP] Integrate the existing _Maple UI library and tokens
issues.delivered: Narrow, vendored Maple Button/Select/Field/Icon primitives and generated chrome tokens are documented; no sibling checkout or photo backend is required.
issues.remaining: Finish source inventory, update procedure/notices, and explicit chrome specimen/light-dark acceptance. Do not equate the existing subset with the complete Maple catalog.

issues.title: [MVP] Bundle the editor in WKWebView with a typed native bridge
issues.delivered: Bundled WKWebView, native dialogs/menu routing, typed errors, exact app hostname/origin and canonical resource containment are merged and verified.
issues.remaining: Fresh empty-cache/hostile-frame/fallback/manual native clipboard acceptance remains; package cross-process coordination remains #7.

issues.title: [MVP] Define the scene graph and validate the CRDT and undo contract
issues.delivered: Versioned semantic scene, Yjs field maps, atomic commands, origin-aware grouped undo, journal replay and a bounded Automerge/Yjs diagnostic are implemented.
issues.remaining: Complete comparative text/drag/reparent/delete/convergence fixtures, unknown-field migration contract, repeated startup/memory/growth measurements and a final CRDT/storage decision.

issues.title: [MVP] Implement local .syrup persistence, autosave and crash recovery
issues.delivered: Managed/named packages, serial autosave, immutable history snapshots, external-conflict protection, browser IndexedDB, native recovery and forced-restart history are verified.
issues.remaining: Canonical manifest/scenes/tokens/assets/log package, append/compaction crash injection, quota/disk-full/permission fixtures and coordinated final writes remain. Current checkpoints have a 32 MB limit.

issues.title: [MVP] Complete Just-Maple Canvas navigation and selection
issues.delivered: Vendored Whiteboard camera, pan/zoom/fit, culling, mixed geometry, hit testing, drag/corner resize, cancellation and grouped undo are delivered. Layers indexing is linear.
issues.remaining: Finish all-direction resize/rotation editing, snapping/distribution, rotated-parent gesture coverage, complete locked/hidden keyboard parity and Layers DOM virtualization. Canvas replaced the obsolete hybrid Design renderer.

issues.title: [MVP] Add artboards, drawing primitives, editable text and layers
issues.delivered: Artboards/frames/groups/basic primitives/images/layers and multiline editing exist. Portable typography, offline bundled font, local-font diagnostics and Unicode geometry are merged in #54.
issues.remaining: Interactive path/freehand/connector tooling, world-placement reparenting and native IME/caret/advanced text editing remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Implement CSS stacks, grid and responsive constraints
issues.delivered: Free/row/column/basic grid, gap/padding/fixed/fill/hug/percent and Canvas/DOM parity are verified; typography from #54 is merged.
issues.remaining: Wrap, bounded fr/minmax/auto-fit, full child constraints/pins and stack drag reorder remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Add design token import, bindings and CSS export
issues.delivered: Document-owned opaque sRGB colors, color aliases, bindings, literal precedence and color token import/export are implemented.
issues.remaining: Extend typed registry to dimension/radius/typography/shadow and light/dark modes; pin the supported DTCG version and cover aliases/cycles/mode round trips.

issues.title: [MVP] Build the component registry, library picker and instance overrides
issues.delivered: Local masters/instances, recursive structural propagation, named style variants, local overrides, detach/reset and dependency-complete paste are verified.
issues.remaining: Production registry metadata/props/slots/states, Checkbox, optional library mappings and compatible component swaps with loss previews remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Implement Repeat Grid with text and image data overrides
issues.delivered: Undoable Repeat Grid creation and text population, deterministic preview/export and checkpoint round trips exist.
issues.remaining: Replace eager structural cloning with template/per-cell semantics; retain stable cell IDs on resize; add image overrides, named field mapping, CSV/JSON validation and grid handles.

issues.title: [MVP] Add isolated responsive preview and click-through prototyping
issues.delivered: Cross-page navigation, responsive presets/dissolve and typed forms/overlay focus/reset/retained state/deleted-target diagnosis are merged in #56.
issues.remaining: A separate native preview window and its lifecycle/cleanup acceptance remain. The form slice does not close this parent.

issues.title: [MVP] Show component names, tokens and code targets in developer preview
issues.delivered: Inspector exposes authored name, local master/instance/variant/override identity and working portable copy actions.
issues.remaining: Show production design-system source/version/platform mappings, state, token identity and authored-versus-measured rules; verify nested keyboard inspection and each advertised copy payload.

issues.title: [MVP] Copy portable Angular, semantic HTML, Tailwind 4 and CSS
issues.delivered: Semantic HTML/Angular/Tailwind consumers compile/render; typography plus typed/password/disabled form controls and action metadata are merged.
issues.remaining: Pinned mapped library snippets, classes-only payloads and self-contained asset/style packaging remain; consumers supply navigation/overlay handlers.

issues.title: [MVP] Copy idiomatic SwiftUI with optional design-system mappings
issues.delivered: SwiftUI consumers compile with weights/padding, supported family/tracking/alignment and typed TextField/SecureField, initial-state bindings, disabled labels and Button callbacks from #56. Unsupported features reject explicitly.
issues.remaining: Supported visual equivalence, self-contained image assets and actual pinned native component mappings remain. Custom fonts and nondefault exact line height still reject.

issues.title: [MVP] Copy and paste editable UI elements across documents
issues.delivered: Versioned editable clipboard preserves nested master/variant/token dependencies, remaps identity and undoes atomically; browser envelope/native text fallback exists.
issues.remaining: Add native custom pasteboard type, permission-denied/manual fallback acceptance, sanitized HTML/common-Tailwind import allowlist and cross-app clipboard/assets tests. Arbitrary source remains unevaluated.

issues.title: [MVP] Import local assets and export selection as SVG or PNG
issues.delivered: Local raster assets, SVG/PNG supported exports, decode diagnostics, replacement and undo are implemented.
issues.remaining: Local fonts/catalog/crop-fit behavior, supported SVG import coverage, mixed-content 1x/2x export fixtures, cancellation and missing-font/oversize/external-asset cases remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Bring up the MCP server and live editor command loop early
issues.delivered: Real native SDK HTTP/stdio, all advertised input/output contracts, pointer readback, revisions/atomicity/retry/undo/capture, typed errors/auth/Host/Origin, occupied-port, throttle and clean credential-rotating stop/restart are verified.
issues.remaining: Complete feature-specific coverage/resources/scoped reads remain #27/#50.

issues.title: [MVP] Validate the complete offline design-to-code workflow and package release
issues.delivered: Model/browser/consumer/native/MCP/recovery gates passed for PR #45; source/evidence and CI links are available.
issues.remaining: All remaining MVP acceptance, measured end-to-end performance/100 MB stress, VoiceOver/offline fresh-launch and release artifact/install/rollback/signing status must be recorded before release.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add peer collaboration, mobile companion and Git history
issues.delivered: No peer networking/mobile companion/Git integration was added by the Canvas port.
issues.remaining: Create a follow-up RFC and distinct peer/mobile/Git slices with convergence, authenticated pairing, input parity and conflict-recovery fixtures.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add advanced vector editing
issues.delivered: Basic paths/vector serialization exist; advanced geometry was not shipped.
issues.remaining: Define geometry fixtures and implement Bezier handles, booleans, masks and flattening in separate slices, with preview/export parity and profiling.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add prototype state machines, auto-animate and voice
issues.delivered: Click navigation/Back/dissolve are the current prototype subset.
issues.remaining: Variables/conditions/advanced triggers/auto-animate/springs/voice need separate deterministic supported-trigger slices and permission/offline/reduced-motion acceptance.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Extend code linkage and native export coverage
issues.delivered: Portable export and explicit unsupported diagnostics exist; arbitrary repository source is never implicitly executed.
issues.remaining: Add verified repository/Storybook linkage and named native targets. Production library manifests and isolated executable previews are now dedicated follow-ups.

issues.title: [Post-MVP] Add automatic responsive inference and advanced component behavior
issues.delivered: Manual supported layouts and simple local named variants exist.
issues.remaining: Automatic inference/explanations, advanced Grid, slots/nested contextual variants and image/vector-mask repeated overrides remain.

issues.title: [MVP] Extend the early MCP loop to complete feature coverage and native packaging
issues.delivered: Native HTTP/stdio, shared commands, durable autosave, revision-bound capture and every advertised output schema, lifecycle/throttle/occupied-port/errors are verified and merged #53.
issues.remaining: Complete remaining feature-specific tools, examples/resources, scoped subtree/cropped reads (#50) and fresh offline full release workflow acceptance. No missing output-schema claim for implemented tools.

issues.title: [MVP] Add portable typography controls and font diagnostics
issues.delivered: All scoped portable typography acceptance passes on main with native/browser/consuming evidence.
issues.remaining: Typography token modes/aliases (#11), file import (#19), advanced wrapping/IME/direction (#9/#10), native custom fonts/exact nondefault line height (#17) remain in parents.

issues.title: [MVP] Add typed form inputs and overlay prototype actions
issues.delivered: All scoped typed-form/overlay acceptance passes on main: 47 model tests / 287 assertions, 17 browser suites, actual native MCP/WKWebView and compiled consumers. Runtime values do not alter the authored checkpoint/undo journal.
issues.remaining: Separate native windows (#14), validation/submission and richer controls/state machines (#12/#24) remain outside this completed slice.

issues.title: [MVP] Import Repeat Grid data with named fields and local images
issues.delivered: Tracked with scoped acceptance; not implemented.
issues.remaining: CSV/JSON import maps named text/image fields in documented row-major order with explicit truncation/missing-value rules. Validation reports malformed data, unknown fields and bad image bytes before any partial mutation. Grid row/column edits retain stable cell identity and surviving overrides; one import is one undoable command batch. Template edits preserve per-cell data; images remain content-addressed/self-contained through paste, save/reopen and export. Real browser/native fixtures cover resizing, mapping preview, cancellation, empty/oversized data and deterministic consuming output.

issues.title: [MVP] Connect a pinned production UI library through a component manifest
issues.delivered: Tracked with scoped acceptance; not implemented.
issues.remaining: Versioned manifest declares package/version, component symbols/imports, typed props, slots, states/variants, token mappings and platform support. Import validates identifiers/types/version collisions and reports unsupported entries before mutation; library absence has an editable semantic fallback. Library picker/inspector retain source identity, selected props/variant, local overrides and declared dependencies across paste/save/reopen. Optional mapped web/native snippets compile against the actual pinned library APIs in isolated consumers. Document offline behavior, safe update/remapping rules, incompatible changes and unsupported platforms; include a non-Maple fixture.

issues.title: [MVP] Add scoped MCP reads and bounded editor discovery
issues.delivered: Tracked with scoped acceptance; not implemented.
issues.remaining: Versioned input/output schemas describe scope, ordering, pagination/limits, coordinate units and supported capabilities. Scoped reads include exact document/revision and required component/token references; unknown IDs and stale document targets fail explicitly. Add cropped/revision-bound capture with bounded dimensions, render throttling and diagnostics; raw file access is not exposed. Actual HTTP/stdio fixtures compare scoped results with the authoritative scene after human/agent edits and undo. Measure response size/time on 1,000/10,000-node fixtures and bound work to the requested scope where possible.

issues.title: [PoC] Validate isolated JavaScript and Swift UI-library previews
issues.delivered: Tracked with scoped acceptance; not implemented.
issues.remaining: Record architecture/trust boundaries, opt-in build/import flow, offline dependency strategy and unsupported/error policy. A web-library fixture renders typed manifest props in an isolated runtime with no document filesystem/native bridge access. A SwiftUI fixture renders through an explicit native helper contract; builds have time/resource bounds, cancellation and stale-result rejection. Typed events return through a narrow contract without allowing privileged editor commands or arbitrary host file access. Compare editability, fidelity, accessibility, latency and package size with the semantic Canvas/DOM path, and record a go/no-go before production rollout.

issues.title: [Engineering] Recover review timeouts and completed-session cleanup failures
issues.delivered: A candidate adds polling state/counter diagnosis, bounded transient cleanup retry and main-only exact-session recovery guarded by trusted reviewer references and API identity/source. All 19 reviewer tests and both bundles pass locally.
issues.remaining: Review/merge #58, inspect retained #52 sessions and recover completed published #54/#56 sessions using the repository secret. Retain failed/unpublished sessions and record actual outcomes.
